name: The Dragon Conquers
description:
You have been challenged by a dragon's roar.

Your Melee and Accuracy are reduced by -1 when attacking creatures other than the one that challenged you.

If you cast a targeted offensive spell that does not target the creature who challenged you, the Complexity of the spell is increased by +1.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, the challenger becomes Incapacitated, or they are Dying.
